detail.longDescription: I'm running Eclipse IDE for Java 2023-06 with the DevStyle plugin installed. I have a github repo that has the workspace inside it (I'm not using the DevStyle git repo option) My setup is: EclipseWorkspace (repo name) - workspace - - all my projects - - .metadata - BuiltJars - ExtraFiles and my aim to be able to cleanly move between a KDE Plasma Fedora 43 laptop running shiftkey (Github desktop fedora port) and a windows 11 pc running github desktop. Both have Eclipse 2023-06 and DevStyle. The actual problem is that the metadata keeps breaking when I swap OS's. Every time I have to bulk re-add the projects, re-assign the JRE to JDK20 and re-add the projects to my working sets, which is extremely time consuming and defeats the whole purpose of using a git repo over a USB stick (as I was doing before however I wanted version control) Basically, is there a plugin or easy fix that I can use or do I just need to go back to using a USB stick?
